scope.area: Signature event operating suite and reusable global event journeys
requirements: Real Signature Productions Giannis Ploutarchos and Andromache concert March 20 2027 at Parkview Manor: source-faithful room/table explorer, original poster and floor plan, physical venue tour, responsive guest planning and organizer operations. Printed 100–275 prices confirmed per guest; currency/tax/fees remain unconfigured.

Front stage sponsor lounges: two facing white five-seat benches with a central table, approximately ten people. Side stage lounges: open rectangular white seating around a central area, approximately twenty-five or more. Do not assign these descriptions to numbered inventory without organizer confirmation.

Organizer imports and edits price lists, photographs, menu sections, bottle packages, modifiers, allergens, explicit taxes/service charges/currency, stock, service zones, last-order cutoffs and age/staff checks. Preview before publish; version conflicts and rollback; no inferred free prices or stock.

Guest ordering from verified table context routes bottles/drinks to assigned servers and bar queues with accepted/preparing/ready/delivered/rejected states, staff override audit, sold-out recovery, duplicate-request protection and reconnect reconciliation.

Full bill splitting before and during event: ticket shares, own items, equal/custom amounts, shared bottle allocations, discounts, taxes, service charge, optional tips, paid/refunded balances, cash staff receipts, outstanding shares and late orders. Exact money conservation and concurrent payment reservation; no client-paid status.

Temporary inventory holds with expiry, atomic table/seat confirmation and payment reconciliation. Distinguish source-plan preferences, private saved plans, enquiries, held inventory and actual tickets; no fabricated available seats.

Subtle disclosed actionable sponsorship on table details, bottle/menu context and event screens: active scoped organizer-approved placements, frequency caps, offer expiry, redemption authorization, accessible touch alternative to hover, no automatic popups covering seat or checkout controls.

Event social sharing: shareable public event cards and deep links, opt-in guest photo/video submissions and hashtags, organizer moderation, content rights and people permission, revocation/removal, screen-safe projection, expiry, reporting, event-scoped media retention and authorized provider ingestion. Hashtag alone is not public-screen consent.

Drag and drop for authorized organizer table layouts, sponsor placements and menu order, and guest-owned group/itinerary/shared-item organization. Keyboard/buttons alternative, touch support, undo, stale versions, permission checks; guests cannot change inventory or other groups.

Scoped messaging: guest-to-organizer questions, private invited-group planning, table-to-assigned-server assistance, order-linked issues, staff handoff, block/report, mute, rate limits, attachment checks, participant revocation, delivery receipts and no cross-tenant or cross-table leakage.

Owner setup/readiness dashboard connects actual business ownership, venue, inventory, catalog, staff routing, taxes, policies, merchant account and moderation team before activating operational features. No payment information entered for the current sales showcase.

Web, iOS and Android journey parity assessed explicitly; native deep links, upload/camera, QR scan, notification permission, offline/foreground recovery and accessible interactions. Responsive web alone is not native delivery.

Acceptance includes simultaneous last-seat/last-bottle requests, expired holds, double clicks, uncertain responses, stale quotes, payment/webhook duplication, voids/refunds, staff turnover, venue/table transfer, social-content takedown during display and inaccessible provider embeds.

scope.area: Site-wide following, reputation and contextual reviews
requirements: Visible unobtrusive Follow on eligible canonical business, professional, artist, church, organization and other entity homes, discovery cards and relevant map/community surfaces; reuse a shared capability rather than source-specific one-offs.

Follow/unfollow persists to the real account, is idempotent and account-scoped, handles signed-out return intent, duplicate taps, unknown responses and account changes; user controls notification categories, frequency, mute and unsubscribe.

Compact truthful review summary and accessible detail drawer or page: ratings, written experience, optional approved photos, rating distribution, useful sorting/filtering, helpful votes and business response where appropriate. No fake rating/count or imported review misattribution.

Purpose-appropriate review eligibility: business service/event experience differs from reviewing a person or religious belief. Define allowed contexts and avoid blanket reputation scores for sensitive identities or children.

Real review write/edit/delete/report flows with current authorization, rate limits, duplicate/self-review and conflict-of-interest controls, abuse moderation, reviewer privacy and an appeal path; owner responses require current ownership.

Only label verified visit or purchase when linked to actual eligible booking/order evidence, without exposing private transaction data; never infer verification from a scraped source or mere account registration.

Passive contextual prompts after a completed eligible interaction, frequency caps and dismissal persistence; never interrupt checkout, demand a positive review or gate review solicitation by satisfaction.

Shared web/iOS/Android capability audit and end-to-end evidence, including aggregate consistency after edits/removal, moderation visibility, concurrent writes, revoked owners and notification delivery preferences.
